svg.aria-label: Sollis Health hs-TnI 0/2-hour chest pain pathway
svg.title: Original Sollis chest pain pathway with updated baseline hs-TnI cutoff of 4.1 ng/L
svg.text: Initial hs-trop ≥ 4.1 and delta < 4 ng/L AND
Initial hs-trop ≥ 4.1 and delta ≥ 4 ng/L but
0 h < 4.1 with onset > 3 h and HEART ≤ 3,
or 0 h < 4.1 + 2 h delta < 4 and HEART ≤ 3
